title: Floor for a deterministic engine: read flip rates against a non-zero trivial edit
description: A deterministic engine has an ask-twice floor of zero, but a trivial edit that changes no protected signal (a second name from the same pool) still flips a few per cent of its answers. Reading gender flip rates against zero therefore overstates the excess. Give every engine a trivial-edit floor for the pronoun-swap tasks (a same-signal edit of similar size), record it, and use it in the excess and detection rule. Remove the borrowed-floor fallback that copies a floor from another task.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: every engine, including deterministic Laya, is read against a non-zero trivial-edit floor.
